children: RNS Number : 0291W  Hungarian Export-Import Bank Ltd  23 September 2026

Hungarian Export-Import Bank Private Limited Company (registered office: H-1065 Budapest, Nagymező u. 46-48., company registration number: Cg.01-10-042594, registered by the Commercial Court of the Metropolitan Court of Budapest, hereinafter referred to as "the Issuer") informs the capital market actors that the holder of ownership rights over the Issuer, by its founder's resolution with effect from 22nd September 2026
1.   has recalled Mrs. Andrea TORZSA from the Supervisory Board and from the Audit Committee of the Issuer;
2.   has recalled Mr. Tamás BALÁS from the Supervisory Board and from the Audit Committee of the Issuer;
3.   has recalled Mr. Balázs KOHUT from the Supervisory Board and from the Audit Committee of the Issuer;
4.   has recalled Mr. László PARRAGH from the Supervisory Board of the Issuer;

5.   has appointed Mr. István SALGÓ as chairman of the Supervisory Board of the Issuer for a fixed term of five years and as a member of the Audit Committee of the Issuer for the duration of his membership of the Supervisory Board of the Issuer;

6.   has appointed Mrs. Éva KOZÁK as a member of the Supervisory Board of the Issuer for a fixed term of five years and as a member of the Audit Committee of the Issuer for the duration of her membership of the Supervisory Board of the Issuer;

7.   has appointed Mr. László JANKOVICS as a member of the Supervisory Board of the Issuer for a fixed term of five years and as a member of the Audit Committee of the Issuer for the duration of his membership of the Supervisory Board of the Issuer;
